nativeProcessRestarts.scope: Local forced process restarts, 1 CPU / 1 GiB; graph and image already present; excludes graceful shutdown/drain; not Cloudflare cold start.

platformTelemetry.note: Selected tail events only; filtered to omit all request headers and credentials. These include startup and route operations; not complete request coverage.

cleanup.deployedResources: Workers, private graph bucket and container application retained; native instance explicitly destroyed and stopped state verified

deployedNativeStoppedStarts.scope: Deployed native route after explicit container.stop(); shutdown excluded

excludedStopSignalOnlyTrial.reason: SDK stop() only sends SIGTERM; early 150-206 ms measurements did not verify shutdown and are excluded from cold-start results. Endpoint now awaits destroy() and runner verifies stopped state.

nativePlatformTelemetry.note: Selected safe fields only; all request headers omitted; incomplete coverage

smallContainer.excludedTrials: Overlapping small cold/scooter trials excluded; isolated runs used instead.
